headline: During an appearance on Popcast, Baby made it clear that he doesn’t believe every release
body: During an appearance on Popcast, Baby made it clear that he doesn’t believe every release has to be a hit for his position in the game to change. “At the level I’m at, if I put out a hit, I don’t put out a hit, you still up here. It don’t really change for me. ” Lil Baby says his status speaks for itself regardless of how every song performs. (via The New York Times’ Popcast) lilbaby.
